summary.headline: Vikran Engineering standalone H1 FY27 revenue rose 26% to INR424 crores and PAT rose ~72% to INR25.4 crores, but consolidated PAT fell to INR6.7 crores on NOPL-related costs.
summary.overview: Standalone revenue grew about 26-27% YoY in H1 FY27 to INR424 crores, with PAT up ~72% to INR25.4 crores, while standalone EBITDA was flat at ~INR48 crores and margin fell to 11.3% from 14.3%. Q2 standalone EBITDA margin fell to 9.1% from 14.4%, which management attributed to escalated direct costs whose price-variation recovery (INR13-16 crores on non-NOPL projects) is not yet certified by clients. Consolidated Q2 PAT was INR2.75 crores versus INR9.12 crores a year ago. Management said NOPL solar disbursement from IREDA is imminent after a delay that slowed panel dispatch and revenue recognition.

segments.name: Power T&D (Power Grid substations and lines)
segments.commentary: Won two Power Grid orders worth ~INR120.69 crores (400 kV GIS, Baroda/Rajgarh) and ~INR153.76 crores (400 kV AIS, Tumkur II, incl. civil works for first STATCOM project). Commissioned 132 kV Miao-Namsai line (~40.6 km, 138 tower foundations) in Arunachal and a 400 kV GIS substation at Malerkotla about two months early, using process bus. Management says ~30% of the ~INR6,200 crore order book is T&D.

segments.name: Solar EPC (NOPL, Maharashtra)
segments.commentary: EPC contract ~INR3,517 crores for 152 locations, 969 MWac / 1,163 MWp, executed across eight clusters. About 18 sites (~90 MW) commissioned and a further ~100 MW near completion. IREDA loan of INR2,941 crores at 9.15% against ~INR4,200 crore project cost; first disbursement expected within about a week per management. Power sales expected INR40-50 crores in H2 FY27; peak power sales over INR500 crores a year at full capacity.

segments.name: Water (Jal Jeevan Mission)
segments.commentary: Received about INR45 crores of Jal Jeevan funds in H1 FY27; management expects the fund flow to continue.

guidance_outlook: Standalone revenue guidance: cross INR2,300 crores for FY27 (per management), with power sales additive; management targets ~INR850-900 crores in Q3 and the balance in Q4.
Consolidated FY27 revenue guided at INR950-1,000 crores; consolidated FY28 guidance of INR2,400-2,500 crores was affirmed in answer to an analyst's figure.
EBITDA margin guided at around 15% (plus or minus 1%) on T&D work, and management said it expects to maintain 14%+ margins for the full year, with price-variation certification expected mainly in H2.
NOPL completion targeted by end of Q1 FY28, with possible spillover into Q2 FY28; about 500 MW to be pushed this financial year.
Management says the company is cash positive and will remain so through the year; debtor days expected to fall 40-50 days vs last year.

Management expects NOPL to generate ~INR100 crores of free cash flow a year (later restated as INR130 crores), with EBITDA of 85-88% and PAT of ~12% (INR70-75 crores) including depreciation at full run-rate.
CWIP of INR740 crores (mainly NOPL) expected to be capitalised in H2 FY27.
Plans for a UAE international base and co-investment projects; management said it hopes to share good news by the next earnings call.
capex_capacity: NOPL: about 18 sites (~90 MW) commissioned; ~100 MW at advanced stage, expected in the next couple of months; ~150 MW of other projects to be commissioned in Q4 per management.
Equipment procurement for NOPL reportedly ordered and capacity blocked; panels (~60-65% of solar cost) had been held back pending disbursement.
About 10% of the NOPL land is not yet identified; management said it is confident this can be resolved.
Standalone CWIP of about INR740 crores, mainly NOPL, to be capitalised as commissioning proceeds.
Data centre opportunities are being largely declined except very high-profit, urgent ones.
demand_pricing: Order book cited at ~INR6,200 crores, with ~30% from T&D according to an analyst's read-across (not disputed by management).
Power and water contracts carry price escalation clauses; solar NOPL is a fixed-price contract.
Price-variation revenue of INR13-16 crores on non-NOPL MP and Maharashtra projects not yet recognised pending client certification.
West Asia crisis raised crude-linked input costs; items not covered by price variation saw significant increases, though management expects oil prices to ease before procurement.
Management says most purchases and sales are pass-through; a 30-40% steel price rise could cause disproportionate costs, which it does not expect soon.

qa_highlights.question: Is the price-variation margin hit on NOPL or on non-NOPL EPC, and will it add to EBITDA later?
qa_highlights.answer: Non-NOPL projects (MP and Maharashtra); INR13-16 crores of price-variation revenue is yet to be recognised and will add to EBITDA when certified.

qa_highlights.question: Will substation EPC margins be in line with peers at 15-16%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management guided to similar margins of around 15%, plus or minus 1%, while flagging some uncovered items affected by crude-linked price rises.

qa_highlights.question: How much revenue and PAT will NOPL generate at full run-rate?
qa_highlights.answer: Revenue above INR500 crores a year, EBITDA 85-88%, FCF about INR100 crores (later INR130 crores); PAT including depreciation about INR70-75 crores (~12%).

qa_highlights.question: Why did standalone PAT decline in Q2 despite higher revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Mainly NOPL deferment: panels were not dispatched pending IREDA disbursement, so overheads went unabsorbed; plus price-variation recognition deferred to later quarters.

qa_highlights.question: How much of standalone revenue and cost came from NOPL in Q2, and what is the interest cost outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: About INR7 crores of Q2 standalone revenue was from NOPL; NOPL-related unabsorbed overheads estimated at INR10-15 crores or less (not confirmed). Vikran-level interest INR18-20 crores per quarter; FY27 INR70-75 crores.

qa_highlights.question: Is FY27 revenue guidance achievable given H1 revenue of INR424 crores?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Q2 shortfall was only in NOPL; targets INR850-900 crores in Q3 and the rest in Q4, with IREDA disbursement expected to unlock execution.

risks_watch: NOPL disbursement timing and execution pace: targeted ~500 MW this FY; any slippage keeps revenue and cash flow deferred.
Price-variation certification timing (mostly H2 FY27); delay would keep standalone and consolidated margins compressed.
Consolidated profitability: H1 consolidated PAT of INR6.7 crores against INR14.8 crores last year; NOPL interest and overheads sit in consolidated.
Rising debt: NCD funding and ~INR18-20 crores quarterly interest at Vikran level; management says solar cash flows will service the IREDA loan.
H2 revenue ramp needed: about INR1,875 crores in H2 to reach the INR2,300 crore standalone target, versus INR424 crores in H1.
Input-cost inflation linked to West Asia crisis and crude oil; the ~10% of NOPL land still unidentified.
summary.management_tone: Management was confident and forward-looking on guidance and NOPL ramp-up, but evasive on specifics: it declined to quantify NOPL cost impact on standalone numbers, said it would follow up later, and gave a PAT figure only after prompting. Margin recovery is framed as timing-related (price-variation certification) rather than structural.

growth.why: Management guides standalone FY27 revenue to cross INR2,300 crore (held) and consolidated FY27 to INR950-1,000 crore (cut), backed by a INR6,200 crore order book and ~90 MW NOPL solar commissioned with ~100 MW near completion, though NOPL disbursement delay and unrecognised INR13-16 crore price variation add uncertainty.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Management guides EBITDA margin around 15% (+/-1%) on T&D work, with INR13-16 crores of price-variation revenue to be recognised on certification mostly in H2, versus H1 standalone margin of 11.3% and Q2 at 9.1%.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: About 90 MW of NOPL solar is commissioned, ~100 MW is near completion within a couple of months, and ~150 MW more is slated for Q4 FY27, though NOPL completion is targeted only by end Q1 FY28 and the IREDA disbursement is still pending.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Standalone revenue grew ~26% YoY in H1 to INR424 crores on a ~INR6,200 crore order book, and NOPL power sales of INR40-50 crores are expected in H2 FY27, although H2 needs ~INR1,875 crores to meet the INR2,300 crore target.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Management is deferring exposure to NOPL and focusing only on projects with significant work done, and the ~INR4,200 crore NOPL project cost is already financed by a INR2,941 crore IREDA loan, so no fresh capex is signalled.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Consolidated revenue guidance was cut and the H2 ramp depends on NOPL disbursement, so there is no sign of an upgrade.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Consolidated FY27 revenue was cut to INR950-1,000 crores and standalone needs ~INR1,875 crores in H2 versus INR424 crores in H1, with price-variation certification (INR13-16 crores) pending and Q2 standalone EBITDA margin at 9.1%.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: A UAE international base and co-investment projects are planned, with management hoping to share news by the next earnings call, but no product or launch details were given.

rows.label: Power Grid T&D wins (~INR274 crores)
rows.why: Two Power Grid orders, ~INR120.69 crores (400 kV GIS) and ~INR153.76 crores (400 kV AIS), were won in the period and add to a ~INR6,200 crore order book of which ~30% is T&D.

rows.label: Cash generation and debtor days
rows.why: H1 standalone operating cash flow was a net inflow of INR258 crores against a INR166 crore outflow a year ago, and debtor days are expected to fall 40-50 days, though ~INR18-20 crores quarterly interest weighs on consolidated PAT.

rows.label: IREDA disbursement for NOPL
rows.why: Management said the first disbursement of the INR2,941 crore loan at 9.15% is expected within about a week, which would unlock panel dispatch and revenue recognition on the ~INR3,517 crore NOPL EPC contract.

tone.note: Management was confident on the NOPL ramp, the INR2,300 crore standalone target and ~15% T&D margins, but was evasive on quantifying NOPL cost drag and needed prompting for PAT, while analysts pressed on Q2 margin compression, the consolidated FY27 cut and the H2 revenue ramp.
